name: スター
css: .roulette-wrapper { width: 480px !important; height: 480px !important; position: absolute !important; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); margin: 0 !important; }

.outer-ring { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 520px; height: 520px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(45deg, #ffd700, #ffed4e, #ffd700); box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.6), 0 0 60px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.4), inset 0 0 20px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3); animation: pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; pointer-events: none; }
#roulette-svg-target { background: #1a1a2e; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 0 10px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }

.center-circle { position: absolute; top: 300px; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 100px; height: 100px; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, #2c2c3e 0%, #1a1a2e 70%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px #ffd700, 0 0 0 12px #1a1a2e, 0 5px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5), inset 0 0 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; z-index: 10; }

.center-logo { width: 70%; height: 70%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffd700 0%, #ffed4e 50%, #ffd700 100%); border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 32px; animation: rotate 3s linear infinite; }
@keyframes rotate { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

.pointer { position: absolute; top: 50px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 0; height: 0; border-left: 25px solid transparent; border-right: 25px solid transparent; border-top: 50px solid #ffd700; filter: drop-shadow(0 5px 15px rgba(255, 215, 0, 1)); z-index: 20; }

#spinBtn { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; width: 220px; height: 70px; font-size: 26px; font-weight: bold; color: white; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%); border: none; border-radius: 50px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.5), inset 0 -3px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); transition: all 0.3s ease; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 3px; position: absolute; top: 570px; }

#result { font-size: 36px; font-weight: bold; color: #ffd700; text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(255, 215, 0, 1); animation: glow 1.5s ease-in-out infinite; font-family: 'Yu Gothic', 'Meiryo', sans-serif; position: absolute; top: 650px; width: 100%; text-align: center; }

#legend-area { top: 570px !important; right: 20px !important; width: 160px !important; max-height: 150px !important; background: rgba(26, 26, 46, 0.9) !important; border: 2px solid #ffd700 !important; color: #ffd700 !important; }
